BiblicalUsage: At Carmel the prophets of Baal are told to cut their bullock in pieces and lay it on the wood, and Saul cuts a yoke of oxen in pieces and sends them through all Israel as a summons to war.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cut pieces are a message that cannot be ignored: the sacrifice laid out on Carmel and the summons carried through Israel both say the same thing — the LORD is calling, and I must answer.
